name: known-noise-and-quirks-librarian
description: Identifies confirmed noisy alarms and environmental quirks from the monitors history and live signals, and recommends memory entries (with expected signature and evidence) for a custom quirks store so future runs stop re-flagging them. Recommend-only: it does not write to memory and never records a quirk that could mask a real fault.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on FRI at 07:30 UTC
